family.label: Promoter and Promoter Group (46 holders; includes Mukesh Ambani's own 0.12% and the promoter-group LLPs of which he and his family are the significant beneficial owners)

structure.note: One class of equity shares (fully paid-up shares of ₹10 each; no partly paid shares remain). The Promoter and Promoter Group (46 holders) held 49.11% of all shares at March 31, 2026, just under half. Mukesh Ambani personally held 0.12%; most of the group's stake sits in promoter-group LLPs (Srichakra Commercials LLP 10.93%; Devarshi Commercials LLP, Karuna Commercials LLP and Tattvam Enterprises LLP 8.06% each, per Note 14.2), which are part of the 49.11% and are not listed separately. Life Insurance Corporation of India (6.68%) is the only non-promoter holder above 5%.

notes: Fiscal year 1 April 2025 to 31 March 2026 (data.js fy 'Mar 2026'). All figures come from the RIL Integrated Annual Report 2025-26 (consolidated statements, amounts in ₹ crore; 1 crore = 10 million, so crore / 100 = billions). The PDF is hosted on rilstaticasset.akamaized.net, the asset CDN that www.ril.com/investors/financial-reporting links to for its reports, so it is treated as the company's own host. PDF page numbers refer to that file (two printed pages per PDF page). OWNERSHIP: as at March 31, 2026. The 49.11% promoter-group figure and LIC's 6.68% are percentages of all 1353,24,72,634 shares, including the 1.78% held by the custodian against GDRs. Mukesh Ambani's 0.12% (1,61,04,040 shares, unchanged during the year) is his own registered holding as listed in Note 14.3; the family total includes it, so the two must not be added. No individual figure for his indirect interest through the promoter LLPs is disclosed. Other large institutional holders below 5% are not named in the annual report, so only LIC is listed. RIL's quarterly Reg 31 shareholding patterns (e.g. https://rilstaticasset.akamaized.net/sites/default/files/2026-10/SHP30092026.pdf) returned HTTP 503 on every attempt on November 24, 2026, so the annual report's March 31, 2026 figures are used. DIVIDENDS: ₹7,443 crore paid to equity holders of the company (excludes ₹436 crore paid to non-controlling interests). BUYBACKS: the consolidated cash-flow statement has no share-repurchase line for 2025-26, so 0. STOCK COMP: null. The consolidated statements give no share-based payment expense figure; the Share Based Payments Reserve fell from ₹790 crore to ₹673 crore ('On Exercise of Employee Stock Options' ₹(117) crore), a reserve movement rather than a stated expense. GEOGRAPHY: the secondary segment split is of 'Value of Sales and Services' (₹11,75,919 crore), which is before deducting GST recovered (₹1,00,244 crore); Revenue from Operations is ₹10,75,675 crore.

taxes.notes: Taxes: consolidated 'Taxes Paid (Net)' of ₹9,608 crore = ₹96.08 billion (1 crore = 10 million), net of refunds (standalone figure ₹8,303 crore not used). R&D: null. The consolidated (Ind AS) statement of profit and loss has no R&D line; the only R&D figure is the Board's Report disclosure under the Companies Act for Reliance Industries Ltd standalone ('Expenditure incurred on Research and Development': capital ₹3,317 crore, revenue ₹1,365 crore, total ₹4,682 crore), which is neither consolidated nor purely expensed.

paidout.notes: Fiscal year ended March 31, 2026, from the RIL Integrated Annual Report 2025-26 (consolidated statements). Revenue from operations is net of GST but includes excise duty of ₹18,456 crore (also an expense), so revenueIncludesExcise. Interest paid (financing, added) includes interest capitalised of ₹16,091 crore; the statement does not say whether the capex line also contains capitalised interest, so up to 1.5% of paidOut may be double counted. Interest income (13,538) and dividend income (9,051 from others, 49 from associates) are in investing, not OCF. Lease principal (6,508) noted, not added.

marketcap.notes: One class of equity shares, listed on NSE (RELIANCE) and BSE (500325); the NSE line in INR is used. 13,53,24,72,634 = 13,532,472,634 shares at March 31, 2026, including 24,12,87,828 shares (1.78%) held by the custodian against GDRs (the GDRs, listed outside India, are not priced separately). No partly paid shares remain (the last were forfeited in 2024-25), and there was no bonus issue or split in 2025-26; the year's only change was 99,736 shares issued on exercise of employee stock options. 7,33,866 shares held by associates are not deducted (associates are not subsidiaries, so these are not treasury shares). A newer count from the September 30, 2026 shareholding pattern could not be read: the PDF (https://rilstaticasset.akamaized.net/sites/default/files/2026-10/SHP30092026.pdf) returned HTTP 503 on every attempt on November 24, 2026; changes since March are limited to ESOS allotments.
